Scaling from 1 to 3 replicas and raising the memory limit to 2 GiB. The 512 MiB ceiling was triggering OOM kills under the 8 concurrent requests per second load.
```yaml
replicas: 3
resources:
  limits:
    memory: 2Gi
    cpu: 1500m
  requests:
    memory: 1Gi
    cpu: 500m
```
The horizontal-scale change preserves the pod autoscaler upper bound at 10 which caps cluster cost.
